verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover both halves of the story inside the PR. Finishing Touches offers one-click agentic actions that "fix review findings," and suggested changes can be applied to the PR with a single click, without copy-paste or context switching. Supporting docs add that CodeRabbit generates the code changes for fixes, offers improvement commands, and posts suggested fixes for CI failures. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the one-click fix and agentic follow-up flows work as described in practice.
